evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Stating a mandatory process as universal fact invokes the authority of an agreed-on process — legitimate power — without explicit pressure or persuasion.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Supplying a factual timeline of replacement controls the informational basis for the process's authority; no influence attempt is directed at a listener.
